home.heroSub: Preserving and presenting Dodlapahad's annual Sri Durga Bhavani Utsav celebrations, sacred traditions, photo & video archives, and community devotion.
home.samitiIntro1: The Durga Bhavani Seva Samiti, Dodlapahad was established to preserve, coordinate, and conduct the revered annual Sri Durga Bhavani Navaratri festival with devotion, unity, and community discipline.
home.samitiIntro2: Each year, nine nights of divine worship, sacred Chandi Homams, cultural presentations, and community feeding (Annadanam) culminate in the grand Vijaya Dashami Shobha Yatra.
home.selectedAlbumsDesc: Explore moments of joy, devotion, and community solidarity captured during our annual celebrations.
home.sevaDesc: Beyond ceremonial worship, Durga Bhavani Seva Samiti strives to strengthen fellowship, service, and cultural awareness in Dodlapahad.
home.annadanamDesc: Providing wholesome consecrated meals to thousands of devotees and visitors during the nine sacred days of Navaratri without distinction.
home.youthDesc: Engaging local youth in cultural performances, palanquin coordination, crowd management, and digital media preservation.
home.cultureDesc: Encouraging traditional music, Kolatam folk dance, Vedic recitation, and festive ornamentation so village arts flourish for future generations.

about.title: About Durga Bhavani Seva Samiti
about.intro: The dedicated committee coordinating religious rituals, community welfare, and cultural celebrations at Sri Durga Bhavani Temple, Dodlapahad.
about.purposeP1: Durga Bhavani Seva Samiti, Dodlapahad was established through the collective initiative of village elders, devotees, and youth. The Samiti functions as an honorary volunteer organization charged with the planning, fundraising, spiritual sanctity, and logistical execution of the annual Navaratri celebrations.
about.purposeP2: The committee fosters a spirit of inclusivity, ensuring that devotees from all walks of life actively participate in festival rituals, cultural programs, and community dining.
about.purposeP3: With the launch of this digital portal, the Samiti takes a progressive step toward transparent governance, digital preservation of photographic archives, and timely dissemination of temple notices.
about.resp1: Upholding traditional Vedic rituals, daily alankarams, and festive sanctity.
about.resp2: Conducting mass Maha Annadanam (community feeding) for all visitors.
about.resp3: Mobilizing village youth for cultural volunteering, traffic, and palanquin seva.
about.resp4: Preserving photographic, historical, and archival memories of each celebration.
about.membersDesc: In accordance with committee policy, individual administrative records, office-bearer lists, and contact details will be reviewed and published upon formal authorization.

history.title: History of Sri Durga Bhavani Utsav - Dodlapahad
history.desc: The annual celebrations of Sri Durga Bhavani Utsav - Dodlapahad began in 2024, with the year 2026 marking our third year of celebrations.
history.badge: Sri Durga Bhavani Utsav - Dodlapahad Timeline
history.bannerDesc: The worship of Sri Durga Bhavani is central to the spiritual and communal life of Dodlapahad. Our annual Sri Durga Bhavani Utsav celebrations began in 2024, bringing together devotees and villagers in collective prayer, devotional rituals, and community service. The year 2026 marks our third year of celebrations.
